description: S3 buckets not encrypted with KMS keys

The supplier and customer database, with names, NIFs and IBANs, accepts connections from the whole internet with a password that was committed to a contractor repository, so anyone holding the password can read or alter every IBAN used for payments
threat_source: Opportunistic scanning of port 5432; anyone with access to the contractor's repository
vulnerability: publicly_accessible = true; 0.0.0.0/0 on 5432; password in Terraform state; no backups

description: Any GitHub repository in the world can assume the ci-deploy role, which can create and update Lambda functions and pass any role to them, so a stranger's workflow can run code as the invoice processor and read every invoice and the database secret
assets: invoice-processor Lambda and its role (2 accounts); tagus-invoices-prod (1184 processed invoices, est. 300 suppliers)
threat_source: Any GitHub user; evidence that a repository outside Tagus assumed the role on 2025-11-25
vulnerability: OIDC trust without a sub condition; iam:PassRole on *; lambda:CreateFunction

description: The public website bucket holds a copy of the compromised WEB-01 web root and its /etc, readable by anyone on the internet, including configuration files with credentials and the server's private keys
threat_source: Anyone who lists or guesses the object keys; search engines
vulnerability: public bucket policy on the whole bucket; migration files left in place

description: Reads of objects in the invoice buckets are not recorded anywhere that lasts, so if invoices are stolen we will not be able to say which ones, or whose, when we notify
assets: tagus-invoices-prod (1184 processed invoices), tagus-ci-artifacts (1 export of production customers)
threat_source: Any principal with read access, including a stolen instance or CI credential
vulnerability: CloudTrail S3 data events off (muted in Prowler for cost); server access logs written into the same bucket and deleted after 7 days

description: The customer portal on WEB-02 runs PHP 7.4 with the instance metadata service in version 1, so a server-side request forgery in the portal hands the instance role's credentials to whoever finds it
assets: WEB-02 (1 instance) and every invoice its role can read (1184)
threat_source: Internet attacker probing the customer portal
vulnerability: IMDSv1 enabled (muted in Prowler); PHP 7.4 end of life; role can read the whole invoice bucket
